blurb: Captain Ken Devey offers fishing charters on Lake Ontario from Williamson, NY. Guests fish for trout, salmon, bass, and other species using a fully equipped 30' Penn Yan boat. Instruction is available for beginners and hands-on experience for the experienced.
extraNote: Discount for booking 2 or more consecutive full days: $50 off each additional day · Trip time starts when first line goes into water, not dock to dock · In case of uncontrollable events reducing fishing hours, trip will be pro-rated · Weather report call at last possible hour; option to cancel or rebook if bad weather · Hughes Marina, Williamson, NY 14589, USA · April to November

quotes.text: Ken - It is always a pleasure going on your charter whether it is in the Spring of early Fall. We have always caught fish every time we have gone over the years. Also, it is an extreme honor to fish with Ken as he is a United States Marine Veteran, I am a United States Navy Veteran and feel very comfortable sailing with Ken. Thank you for your service Ken and semper fidelis brother. So, veteran's contact our brother in arms for a charter!! You will never regret the fishing or your trip with Captain Ken!! All my charters are a great time and memorable.

Captain Ken,Let me tell you what a pleasure it was to fish on the Stingray this week. The boys and I had such a fantastic time with you and Jim that we can not stop talking about it!You will be highly recommended when I am asked. We will look to book again asschedules permit if possible. Please let me know if I can ever write a personal testimonial for your website, I would be pleased to do it.

Ken,Just wanted to let you know how much Saule and I enjoyed our fishing trip with you. We had fun and both feel we connected with our kind of person. It was a pleasure to meet you and spend a day with you. I would recommend you and your charter service to anyone and especially any family with kids looking for a day on the water with fish and a great guy. We will be back next season!

Captain Ken,you took myself and my son chase out fishing on August 4th and 5th. We just wanted to thank you for all your hard work. We really appreciate you staying out late with us on the second day and finding us that big salmon. Your dedication and generosity working with us was above and beyond what we could have hoped for. Thanks again and we hope to see you soon.

Ken,Just wanted to say thanks for the trip. My grandson really enjoyed it, as you can tell by the smile on his face. We’re talking about a trip sometime in August hoping for a salmon.Again, Thanks for everything.

Hello Captain Ken,I want to thank you again for sharing your time and experience with me today. My wife and I both thank you for the beautiful fish!! I learned a lot and look forward to doing it again!!
